Rachel — quick answers below and attachments linked.

- KMS: yes, we can use a customer-managed KMS key for the evidence bucket. We’ll need Acme to provide the key ARN and cross-account access policy; Security/DevOps will verify during setup.
- Proof-of-deletion: Redwood generates an S3 lifecycle + a deletion audit entry. We will provide a signed deletion log (hash + timestamp) when temporary artifacts are removed. This will be part of the evidence package and included in the amendment language.
- Timestamps/metadata: uploads preserve original file timestamps plus we attach an ingestion manifest entry with uploader identity and MD5 checksum.
- Auditor sampling: we’ll export arbitrary subsets via a signed, time-limited export link. 2% random sample is fine; we’ll provide a CSV of selected objects for your auditor.

Attachments included: s3_presign_instructions.pdf (upload steps + sample curl command), soc2_evidence_manifest.csv (template filled with example rows), amendment_docu_sign.pdf (draft amendment to extend retention to 18 months + burst window details).

Commercial note: Karthik — per our internal pricing matrix, if Acme agrees to +20% commit we waive the one-time admin fee and include the 2-week burst at no charge. Please confirm whether we should route a concession approval.

Action: Oliver/procurement to review amendment and sign. Once signed we’ll provision the presigned bucket and send upload credentials.

Thanks —
Irene
